title: Geomagnetic anomalies at UFO hotspots
place_text: Skinwalker Ranch; Mount Sangun Mori, Japan; Hessdalen

tellings.quote: like Skinwalker Ranch or Mount Sangun Mori uh in Japan uh next to the Fukushima Prefecture, their nuclear civilian grid, you always have these geomagnetic anomalies.

plain: Places famous for UFO reports always seem to have odd readings in the Earth's magnetic field, according to Michels, who points to Skinwalker Ranch, a ranch known for reports of strange happenings, and Mount Sangun Mori in Japan, near the Fukushima area and its civilian nuclear power network. Michels says this himself, without naming a source, as a pattern that might hint at why such things show up where they do.
